payload.text: Issue 0650, S, on vc's order of 2026-11-10: the upgrade that writes the tracked hook dispatchers also keeps a marked `<hooks dir>/ export-ignore` block in the project's .gitattributes, in devbin's form, edited in place when present and appended when absent, and only when the hooks directory is inside the work tree; doctor names a project whose hooks directory has tracked files and no export-ignore decision; one test reads git archive after an upgrade in a fresh repository; Intent's own .gitattributes takes the block in the same bank. Worktree tmp/wt-ic-0650 at main bfb81c32d. Banked red at the base and green with the fix, for vc to judge stacked with 0672, 0676 and 0677.
